attempts.summary: Built a 3-member etcd v3.5.17 cluster on node1/node2/node3 (RHEL 9.8), installed from upstream GitHub release binaries and run as a systemd service (etcd.service, user 'etcd', data in /var/lib/etcd), with firewalld opened for 2379/2380. Verified full mesh replication (writes from each node readable on the other two), verified the cluster keeps serving reads/writes with one member down (stopped node3, wrote/read against node1+node2, then restarted node3 and confirmed it caught up to the same raft index). Completed the mandatory node-restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id/health on all nodes, sequentially rebooted node1, node2, then node3 one at a time (preserving quorum throughout), confirmed changed boot_id after each, and confirmed etcd + cluster health + all previously written keys (foo, fromnode2, fromnode3, duringoutage) were present and consistent (raft index 38 on all three) after every restart.
